import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
namibia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[11.7, -17.8], [25.3, -17.8], [25.3, -29.0], [11.7, -29.0], [11.7, -17.8]]
])
zimbabwe = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[25.2, -15.6], [33.1, -15.6], [33.1, -22.4], [25.2, -22.4], [25.2, -15.6]]
])

# MODIS NDVI 16-day composite
collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD13A2').select('NDVI')

# Quality masking function
def mask_quality(img):
    qa = img.select('SummaryQA')
    mask = qa.lte(1)  # Keep good quality (0,1)
    return img.updateMask(mask).copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start'])

# 2. Long-term average (2003-2017, February)
baseline = collection.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2003, 2017, 'year')).filter(
    ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'month')
).map(mask_quality).mean().divide(10000)

# 3. 2019 February (21-28 falls in mid-Feb composite)
feb_2019 = collection.filter(ee.Filter.date('2019-02-01', '2019-03-01')).map(mask_quality).mean().divide(10000)

# Check if collections exist
baseline_size = collection.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2003, 2017, 'year')).filter(
    ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'month')).size().getInfo()
feb_2019_size = collection.filter(ee.Filter.date('2019-02-01', '2019-03-01')).size().getInfo()

print(f"Baseline images: {baseline_size}")
print(f"Feb 2019 images: {feb_2019_size}")

if baseline_size == 0 or feb_2019_size == 0:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Calculate anomaly (2019 - baseline)
    anomaly = feb_2019.subtract(baseline)
    
    # Namibia statistics
    nam_stats = anomaly.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
        geometry=namibia,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).getInfo()
    
    # Zimbabwe statistics
    zim_stats = anomaly.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
        geometry=zimbabwe,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).getInfo()
    
    nam_anomaly = nam_stats.get('NDVI_mean')
    nam_count = nam_stats.get('NDVI_count')
    zim_anomaly = zim_stats.get('NDVI_mean')
    zim_count = zim_stats.get('NDVI_count')
    
    print(f"Namibia anomaly: {nam_anomaly}, pixels: {nam_count}")
    print(f"Zimbabwe anomaly: {zim_anomaly}, pixels: {zim_count}")
    
    if nam_count == 0 or zim_count == 0:
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif nam_anomaly is None or zim_anomaly is None:
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        # More negative = worse vegetation anomaly
        if nam_anomaly < zim_anomaly:
            print("Namibia had worse vegetation anomaly (more negative)")
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("Zimbabwe had worse or equal vegetation anomaly")
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
